question: Which of the following activity is related to the tertiary sector of the economy?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Storage.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The tertiary sector of the economy is also known as the service sector, which provides intangible goods and services to consumers.**
 
• 
 
Tertiary Sector:

 
 
• The sector that helps in the development of the Primary and Secondary sectors through providing services.
 
• Transport, communication, banking, storage, trade, etc. all come under the tertiary or service sector.
